Pytest: 15/16 PASS (test_iter36_byok_anthropic_and_lightbox.py 10/10 PASS; test_iter36_admin_thumbnails.py 5/6 PASS — 1 fail surfaces a real backend bug). Anthropic save→masked badge 'Saved · sk-…cdef'→delete cycle works. Plaintext NEVER leaked in any GET response or db (Fernet 'gAAAAA' prefix verified). Thumbnail lightbox opens, shows image+download+copy+X, dismisses on ESC and backdrop click and X. Admin Usage tab: Thumbnails column present; footer '4 thumbnails'; expand owner row → drilldown shows Thumbnails card (4/Premium:2/Fast:2/last_at). Stats tab: stat-thumbnails tile shows 4. CSV export has columns thumbnails_total, thumbnails_premium, thumbnails_fast, thumbnails_last_at positioned between renders_last_at and spend_cents; owner row = 4/2/2. CRITICAL BUG: clicking the Thumbnails sort header on Admin Usage causes an unrecoverable React crash ('Uncaught runtime errors: Objects are not valid as a React child') because backend rejects sort_by=thumbnails_total with 422 (Pydantic regex missing that value) AND frontend renders the validation-error array (objects with keys {type,loc,msg,input,ctx}) as React children. Two fixes needed: (1) Backend admin_routes.py:713 — extend the sort_by regex to include thumbnails_total (the sort lambda at line 875 already implements it, just unreachable). (2) Frontend UsageTab.jsx — coerce error.response.data.detail to a string before rendering (defence-in-depth).

critical.issue: Returns 422 'String should match pattern ^(last_seen|email|scripts_total|renders_total|spend_cents|added_at)$'. The sort_key_map at admin_routes.py:875 already implements the lambda for thumbnails_total, but the Pydantic Query regex on line 713 doesn't include it — request never reaches the handler. Fix: change the regex on line 713 to '^(last_seen|email|scripts_total|renders_total|thumbnails_total|spend_cents|added_at)$'. This bug is also responsible for the Admin Usage tab UI crash described in frontend_issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Thumbnails sort header crashes the page with 'Uncaught runtime errors: Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {type, loc, msg, input, ctx})'. Root cause: backend returns Pydantic 422 with detail=Array<{type,loc,msg,input,ctx}>, and the component tries to render that array directly as JSX. Even after the backend regex is fixed, the frontend should defensively coerce error.response.data.detail (string OR array OR object) into a single string for the toast. Until fixed, any 422 from this endpoint becomes a hard crash.

integration_issues.issue: Backend 422 + missing frontend error guard → red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay covers the whole admin panel. User must reload to recover.

rca of the issue: RCA: Two-layer bug for sort-by-thumbnails. Layer 1 (backend, admin_routes.py:713) — the Pydantic Query(..., regex=...) validator was added in iter_36 to accept thumbnails sort but the regex string itself wasn't updated, only the sort_key_map dispatch at line 875 was. Result: every request with sort_by=thumbnails_total returns 422 before reaching the handler. Layer 2 (frontend, UsageTab.jsx) — the catch-block renders error.response.data.detail directly as a React child without checking shape. FastAPI/Pydantic v2 returns detail as Array<{type,loc,msg,input,ctx}>, which React refuses to render → 'Objects are not valid as a React child' uncaught crash. Reproduction: log in as owner → /admin → Usage → click the Thumbnails column header. Mitigation: extend regex AND add an extractErrMsg helper that handles array+object+string shapes. Note: this exact crash pattern will recur for ANY future 422 from the admin APIs, so the frontend guard is the more durable fix.
